findings.message: 12 of 12 raw data blocks carry the parametric stereo extension's ID, but the core has 3 channels; decoders apply parametric stereo only to a core of one channel (fdk-aac, ffmpeg), so the report shows the stream without it.

ADTS cannot signal SBR or PS explicitly, but 12 of 12 raw data blocks hold SBR data: the stream is HE-AAC, signaled only implicitly, with an output rate of 44100 Hz. Decoders without SBR play the AAC LC core at 22050 Hz.
